methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's pricing page (or, where the official page blocked automated fetching, from a reputable corroborating source that quoted the published figures) and independently re-verified against live sources on 2026-06-13. Most HR/payroll vendors price as a flat monthly base plus a per-employee/per-person fee, or purely per-seat; per-seat prices are noted with billingModel per_seat and the per-user figure placed in monthlyUsd with a note. Tiers that are sales-quote-only (no published price) have monthlyUsd set to null. Every figure shown was confirmed on a live source; nothing is invented. QuickBooks Payroll was dropped during re-verification because its plan figures could not be confirmed on any single reliable live page (the official page was unreachable and third-party sources disagreed with each other and with the prior figures, compounded by a pending July 2026 price change).
